import sys
p = sys.argv[1]
raw = open(p, 'rb').read()
if raw.startswith(b'\xef\xbb\xbf'):
    raw = raw[3:]
text = raw.decode('utf-8')
out = bytearray()
for ch in text:
    o = ord(ch)
    if o < 0x80:
        out.append(o)
        continue
    try:
        out += ch.encode('cp1252')
    except UnicodeEncodeError:
        if 0x80 <= o <= 0x9F or 0xA0 <= o <= 0xFF:
            out.append(o)
        else:
            raise SystemExit(f'unexpected char {ch!r} U+{o:04X}')
fixed = bytes(out).decode('utf-8')
open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='').write(fixed)
bad = [c for c in ['Â', 'â€'] if c in fixed]
print('fixed; leftover mojibake:', bad)
print('non-ascii chars now:', sorted(set(c for c in fixed if ord(c) > 127)))
